# @rohan9024/retrykit v2.1.0

> Zero-dependency reliability and traffic control for AI applications.

## Documentation map

- [README](README.md): installation and API overview
- [AI coding agents](docs/AI_CODING_AGENTS.md): package versus skill installation
- [Skill](skills/retrykit/SKILL.md): safe integration workflow
- [Full API context](llms-full.txt): modules and reliability invariants

Requires Node.js >=22. Use targeted `wrapOpenAI`/`wrapAnthropic` wrappers, explicit idempotency for unsafe mutations, and `getCheckpoint` for stream resumption.
